items.title: Research (Polish): Does our new five-tab bottom bar follow current guidance for web tab bars on phones?
items.content_text: Mostly yes: named nav of links, aria-current, visible labels, 52px targets, body padding. Two gaps: no viewport-fit=cover, so env(safe-area-inset-bottom) is 0 on notched iPhones and the bar can sit on the home indicator; no scroll-padding-bottom, so jump links or focus can land under the bar. Pitch: add both on phones; check landscape side insets first.

items.title: Research (Pixel): Should our long pages use content-visibility: auto now that it is Baseline?
items.content_text: Not yet. content-visibility is Baseline newly available since Sept 15, 2025, but one measured test found the one-line snippet made a 200-item page slower; it only paid off on long lists with a measured contain-intrinsic-size. Our longest page today is Receipts at about 64 KB, so the win is unproven. No pitch; revisit only if a page grows long enough to measure a gain.

items.title: Research (Advocate): What are readers publicly struggling with about Grok Bot this month?
items.content_text: Loudest November problem is usage: meters jumping to 100% around Nov 1, a weekly-limit reset for all users on Nov 9, and an efficiency update (about 7% more usage, up to 15% on routines). A forum thread reports bots not replying on Nov 13, stopped Nov 14. None is in our known issues. Pitch: Scout and Verify trace these to official sources first.
